title: Building Code AI Implementation
description:
Building codes are massive and slow to search. Building Code MCP connects 16 Canadian codes (NBC, OBC, ABC, BCBC, the Quebec codes, and more, 24,000+ sections) to an AI assistant. You ask in plain language and get back the exact code, section, page, and on-page coordinates.

The key decision was not feeding the model the whole PDF. One code volume is 700k+ tokens, and all 16 don't fit in any context window. So the tool ships a lightweight location index and retrieves only the section that matters per query. That makes the full corpus searchable at all, at about 1/100th the token cost.

It also does two things a raw PDF can't. Every answer carries a verifiable citation (section and page you can check), instead of an invented one. And the public index stores only where a clause lives, never the protected text, so it's copyright safe. Connect your own licensed PDF and full text unlocks on top.
